chunks: And it is narrated from ʿUmar ibn Abī Shuʿbah, who said:
I saw Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام eating while reclining. Then he mentioned the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and said:
"He did not eat while reclining until he died."

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abū ʿAbdillāh, Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.رَسُولَ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.مُتَّكِئًا: in a reclining or leaning posture

ai.seo_question: Did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم eat while reclining?
ai.summary: This hadith reports an observation about the eating posture of Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام and then recalls the practice of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم. It highlights the Prophetic sunnah (prophetic tradition) in matters of everyday etiquette and conduct.
